_: electron-builder's arch vocabulary on the left, the release vocabulary on the right. The right-hand side is GOARCH because the updater runs inside a Go binary and asks runtime.GOARCH who it is: a manifest keyed any other way describes a platform that never comes asking. An arch missing here fails the build rather than shipping a name the manifest cannot resolve.
_fpm: fpm spells the architecture its own way in an .rpm name (x86_64, aarch64) wherever artifactName uses ${arch}; the deb comes out as amd64 already. Each spelling is renamed to the release arch, and one not listed here fails the build.
